decision: Port PR #482 (premortem A2-A10, R1-R6) onto main e106d53 as local branch port/482, finding by finding: port A2, A3/A4, A5, A6 (the -- option terminator only), A7, A8, A9/A10/R1, R2, R3 (file modes), R4, R6 (doc); drop the R5 CI change (main ci.yml already gates Trivy CRITICAL fixable-only) and the A1 'flat single-operator posture' documentation.
rationale: Every ported change was re-validated against origin/main file:line and was still missing. A1 as written ('any admitted identity is a full operator') is contradicted by main's admin-only host-terminal gate and by PR #535's per-owner tenancy RBAC, so documenting it would mislead.
alternatives: Rebase #482 wholesale (rejected: conflicts in ci.yml, CLAUDE.md, connection-handler.ts whose docker spawn moved to server/backends/container.ts, and it would re-add an A1 posture that main no longer has).

decision: Keep lib/ssrf-guard.ts as its own address classifier instead of reusing lib/substrate/egress.ts isNonPublicAddress.
rationale: egress.ts is a port of substrate-harness harness/egress.go that must stay in step with the Go file; the SSRF guard needs fec0::/10 and IPv4-compatible ::/96 handling and allows public NAT64/6to4 embeddings, which would make egress.ts diverge from egress.go.
alternatives: Extend egress.ts (rejected: breaks the Go lock-step); union of both classifiers (rejected: extra complexity for no reachable gain).

decision: Number the auth_audit append-only migration 1781568000600 (after #535's 1781568000500_tenant-settings) instead of #482's 1785632484332.
rationale: main's migrations use the 17815680000N00 sequence. node-pg-migrate's runner refuses an unrun migration that sorts before one already run, so this must land AFTER #535; if it lands first, renumber #535's migration or this one before merging.
alternatives: Keep 1785632484332 (rejected: breaks the sequence convention, and the same ordering issue still applies to every later migration).

decision: R4: OpenCode host mode mounts the daax-scoped ~/.daax-opencode instead of the operator's real ~/.local/share/opencode (or $XDG_DATA_HOME/opencode).
rationale: The real store was mounted read-write into untrusted agent containers. Behaviour change: host-mode operators run `opencode auth login` once inside a daax container. #535 maps the operator onto this same legacy path, so it inherits the scoped store.

decision: A6: port only the `--` before the docker exec target; do not port #482's daax-<8 hex> containerName allowlist.
rationale: main deliberately lets an admin docker exec into any named container (c2ad177; tests/server/handlers/host-shell-admin.test.ts asserts exec into daax-postgres), and #535 scopes non-admins to owner-labeled containers with unlabeled infrastructure admin-only. The allowlist would break that tested design. Residual until #535 lands: a non-admin on a container-mode daax can exec into a named container.
alternatives: Port the allowlist for non-admins only (rejected: duplicates #535's ownership check).

decision: Renumber the auth_audit append-only migration to 1781568000700_auth-audit-append-only.
rationale: Consolidating the open PRs put two migrations at 1781568000600: this one and #523's 1781568000600_digital-workers. node-pg-migrate orders by name, so the two would collide. Workers stays at 600, and this moves to 700, after it.
